description: Backup for Kubernetes clusters with BorgBackup. Deploys a node-backup DaemonSet, a cluster-data-backup CronJob, and a console StatefulSet, each talking to its own Borg repository. Optional Borg UI server with managed agents, and an optional Borg 1/Borg 2 repository server.
Helm chart for deploying the Cluster API Janitor for OpenStack
